controls: p=0 (rung 0 never revisited) as the low anchor

decision_criteria.PHENOMENON_ABSENT: final_r0 is flat in p (revisit share does not shape rung-0 performance in BEE)
decision_criteria.PHENOMENON_CHANGED: final_r0 depends on p but not monotonically (revisiting helps non-linearly)
decision_criteria.PHENOMENON_PRESERVED: final_r0 rises with p (monotone non-decreasing, and the top p beats p=0)

entries.bee: battery over world_params action_delay in {0,1,2,4} (the S2 scaffolding)
entries.reason: action_delay is the same delay knob; the battery evaluates a proposal on all rungs at once

entries.bee: the battery WEIGHT on rung 0 (p); (1-p) split over the harder rungs
entries.reason: a higher weight on rung 0 is more revisiting of it; p=0 drops rung 0 from the battery entirely
entries.source: how often rung 0 is revisited during training

entries.bee: best elite evaluated on action_delay=0 held-out (charge)
entries.reason: the best-by-weighted-battery elite is scored on rung 0 alone

entries.bee: statemachine.v1 evolved under the battery, selector.truncation.v1
entries.reason: one search per p, ranked by the weighted battery objective
BEE reports charge, not a normalised 0..1 competence; only the TREND in p is compared, not the level

prereg.objective: objective.charge.v1 (weighted battery mean during training; rung-0 held-out at evaluation)
observations: final_r0 = best elite's mean held-out charge at action_delay=0, per p
prereg.organisms: statemachine.v1 evolved once per p under the delay-ladder battery
prereg.question: Does training with a higher revisit share p of rung 0 (action_delay=0) raise final rung-0 charge, across the delay ladder {0,1,2,4}? (C2-SFE-06 found final_r0 rose with p.)
prereg.stopping_rules: fixed budget; a flat or non-monotone final_r0(p) is a valid CHANGED/ABSENT result
